reason: The brand translates the product's actual job—compressing scattered footage into a coherent story—into one memorable idea, one visual behavior and one obvious action. The strongest distinction is story-before-timeline plus protected source handling, not generic AI novelty.
releaseNotes: Launch hero must demonstrate a real montage behavior rather than use one static stock image.
Definition should stay readable and secondary to the product promise.
Primary CTA remains Start a Montage.
Do not claim full hosted readiness until deployment and cloud connection proof are green.
